# Certified Group Service lexicons

Copies of the Lexicons this app calls on the Certified Group Service (CGS),
from [certified-group-service](https://github.com/hypercerts-org/certified-group-service/tree/main/lexicons)
at commit `7d67877`. CGS does not publish its Lexicons yet, so `lexicons.json`
resolves these NSIDs from this directory instead of the network.

To update: copy the changed files from the CGS repository, then run
`pnpm lex:install` and `pnpm lex:build`.
